parsing.format: For audited stream vtables, +48h=00be4620: DWORD character count via stream+38h, native allocation, space-fill all logical bytes, then one raw stream+24h read for declared count. Zero count yields empty native string. Short character reads preserve spaces in unfilled suffix; stored count remains declared count.
parsing.embedded_nul: 00718f50 uses strlen rather than native stored count. An embedded NUL truncates final Note text while read budget still charges the bytes actually transferred for the complete serialized counted string.
parsing.short_prefix: Concrete DWORD short reads with nonnull actual-count pointer can retain pointer-address bits in missing prefix bytes; bounded portable projection must reject incomplete DWORD prefixes rather than invent a deterministic length.
parsing.no_implicit_skip: Parser and its helper perform no explicit unread-node skip. Outer dispatcher cleanup and shared-cursor accounting remain the established reader/dispatcher contracts.

assignment.limits: External allocator/reserve, CRT failure/exception, alias-copy and SSO ABI are not reconstructed. Host std::string payload ownership must not be represented as layout-compatible native storage.

destruction.ownership: Native destruction establishes that Note owns its stored characters and outer storage can be independently selected for deletion. Parser returns an item initialized with intrusive reference count1. A host Note DTO with std::string can preserve payload ownership while using a new interface; native reference-count/layout equivalence is not claimed.
